angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 527,341 km at 123.57 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.0924 +/- 0.0190 mas (same row, RUWE 1.23): 123.57 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.758 +/- 0.032 solar radii from Grieves et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-132 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.144G/abstract): 527,341 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.789 +/- 0.039 solar masses from Grieves et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-132 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.144G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4686 +/- 99 K from Grieves et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-132 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.144G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Grieves et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-132 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.144G/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-132.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.576, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-132 (pscomppars): spectral type K4 V, from Grieves et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.144G/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, WASP-132: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-132 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.15 dex, from Grieves et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.144G/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-132 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.57512, from Grieves et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.144G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-132 (pscomppars): age 7.2 Gyr, from Grieves et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.144G/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-132 (pscomppars): rotation period 33 d, from Hord et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....164...13H/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-132 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.3 km/s, from Grieves et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.144G/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
